reviews.comment: I would take if you need a guarantee pass. In class assignments every so often which are mandatory and are group assignments which he grades hard. Tests(2) are very hard but gives GENEROUS curve on each one. Made 26/40 on one and it was a 90. My final grade was a 78 and the curve he gave to everyone was so good I made an A in the course.

We had 2 exams. The first average was a 60 and the second was a 45 (50% of our grade). My final grade in the class was a 68, which ended up being an A in the class! The lectures were not helpful at all! OVERALL, this class was so stressful because basically everyone was failing the entire time until he randomly dropped that out grades were curved.

GEOL 101: Very cool professor, and funny at times. He provides hints in his lectures about things that will be on the exam. I'm not a Geology major, but Professor Kronenberg occasionally had some interesting “wildly” lectures. Make sure to do all the in-class assignments — and actually try. Exams are hard but he is generous with a curve. Gig'em!

Do not take this man's class. He covers MOUNTAINS of material in presentations with 100s of slides of the same single photo and gives no idea of what his exams cover. His final "review session" included and i QUOTE "study things you think are important, and then go ahead and memorize a few things really well even if its not on the exam"
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof. Kronenberg has been my favorite Professor this year. He makes his lectures fun to listen to while providing good information for the exams. There is busy work, its just 2 midterms and a final. He grades on a curve so its not hard to do well in his class. He is very passionate and makes this class fun to take. I would recommend him 100%

I took Geo 101 but it wasn't an option to list here. Kronenberg is very knowledgeable in his subject. Lots of lectures from slides. Tests were very difficult but the curve was incredibly generous. If you study a good amount you should have no problem getting an A in Geo 101.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Just to clarify, I took GEOL 101, as it was not an option to list on here. He is an enthusiastic, kind professor who clearly enjoys what he teaches. Lecture heavy, but overall pretty interesting. Tests are extremely hard, and you are often left lost in the class. However, he is an easy grader. Just do the work and you will get an A.
He's really great if you study. Not super hard exams but they aren't easy either. Will crack some jokes and really passionate about the subject. Loved his course.

Dr. Kronenberg should have a much better score. He is so nice and funny. While there are only three grades all semester, if you study, you'll pass. He is always ready to answer questions and he's just super great. While I don't care much for the subject, he made it super bearable. 10/10 professor. Just put in the work.

Hes a good prof and very passionate about his subject but the tests are really hard and his slides are really long (like 200 slides) and everything is free response. Only 3 things are graded all year.

reviews.comment: This professor is really boring and on top of that his exams are really hard.I would not recommend him to anyone !

Hes friendly and very passionate but my biggest peeve is that I could never figure out what I did wrong on homework. Like, there would be an "x" on hw then no explanation. Id ask , but he was never that willing to help with hw . You have to learn from your mistakes to really learn.
